text:
Zoe (billing): Heads up - saw 12 invoices from the nightly netsuite-batch with truncated memos. Looks like pricing_experiment tag got cut, so Stripe webhook matcher couldn't find experiment_id -> created duplicate invoice rows.
sync-bot: netsuite-batch run: id=ns-batch-2026-06-11-02, invoices=3,720 warnings=12 memo_truncations=12
Mats (eng-billing): Oof. Our CSV formatter limited memo to 50 chars for legacy clients; the experiment label is longer and contains unique suffix used as dedupe key. Root cause confirmed.
Olivia (accounting): Impact: duplicates posted to AR for 12 customers totaling ~$2,850. Need to void duplicates and create reversing JEs before EOD.
Rina (finance-ops): Proposed remediation:
- pause nightly settlement for affected customers
- run dedupe script matching on customer+amount+date window and preserve earliest invoice
- void extra invoices and emit reversal JE
Need Jon approval for manual JE up to $5k.
Jon (CFO): Approved up to $5k. Proceed.
Mats (eng-billing): Hotfix: PR https://github.com/redwood/inference/ops/pull/13001 replaces CSV memo truncation with JSON payload for batch exports and adds unit test. Deploying to canary.
sync-bot: dedupe-job started: job_id=dedupe-2245678901-1 candidates=12
Rina (finance-ops): Dedupe complete: voided=11 retained=1 reversals_created=11 total_reversal_amt=$2,775 audit=/logs/dedupe-2245678901-1
Olivia (accounting): Confirmed AR reconciled and journals posted. I'll notify affected customers.
Zoe (billing): Thanks. Please add a short postmortem to ops notes and an alert for memo_truncation>0 on batch exports.
Mats (eng-billing): Will do. Deployed hotfix to canary and scheduled full deploy after verification.
